messages:
Jordan: quick design pass on Compliance > Storage. uploaded screenshot to the doc.
Leila: nice. top-line nits?
Jordan: a few: 1) retention granularity: some customers asked for hours (eg 6h, 12h) not just days. 2) region defaulting language is confusing when org-level default exists. 3) KMS label doesn't distinguish KMS vs HSM.
Omar: for 1) hours seems fine for short-lived demos. UI idea: dropdown with 'minutes / hours / days' compact selector next to the numeric input.
Fiona: agree, but make sure the input still enforces safe minimums for production orgs (eg not <1h without an explicit warning).
Leila: 2) region UI: current copy 'Default region: us-west-2' implies it's set at account level but we actually route per-request sometimes. Suggest: 'Region (default: us-west-2)' + a small 'learn more' linking to routing docs.
Jordan: good. also KMS: badge just says 'Managed key' which customers read two ways. Propose 'Key custody: Redwood-managed' vs 'Key custody: Customer-managed (BYOK)' and include a tiny HSM icon for HSM-backed keys.
Omar: add SR-only text: 'Using customer-managed key: Redwood does not have key material.' That clears up support tickets.
a11y-check: accessibility quickscan: lock icon contrast 2.4:1 (fail). Recommend darker icon color or add visible text label. Also retention input needs aria-describedby pointing to helper text.
Fiona: audit log: event labels are raw (e.g., `storage.retention.update`)  i'd like 'Retention updated' in the list and raw id in details. Also add a quick filter for 'KMS events' and 'Retention events'.
Leila: filter chips sound good. maybe show a small badge count per filter (e.g., KMS (12)).
Jordan: small UX detail: when changing retention from long->short, show inline consequence banner: 'Immediate purge scheduled in 24h; downloads may be affected' with a link. Avoid modal for small changes.
Omar: agreed. for destructive quick changes (like turning retention to 0) we should have a modal with explicit 'Permanently delete' copy and require typing 'DELETE' for orgs with >1TB.
Fiona: copy pass: prefer 'Permanently delete data after [X]? This cannot be undone.' and short second line: 'Exports for legal holds may persist per policy.'
Leila: keyboard flow: tab order should be toggle->region->retention input->granularity->KMS->save. retention granularity change should announce via aria-live polite: 'Retention unit set to hours'.
a11y-check: ensure the audit filter chips are keyboard-focusable and have aria-pressed states. Also timestamp display: show local tz + relative time.
deploy-bot: FYI staging deploy 2026-06-01 02:30 UTC. include FF `compliance-retention-granularity` for the hours feature.
Jordan: thanks all. i'm going to mock the compact input + granularity and open PR. tagging @Leila @Omar @Fiona for review. :thumbsup:
